errors.text_span: shows a steady increase in MCI
errors.evidence: The description of the Linear SAE method as showing a "steady increase" is an over-generalization, as the plot shows a noticeable dip in value at 1500 demonstrations.
The legend shows the LLaMA-2-chat-7B line style as dash-dot, not dashed.
The line for the LLaMA-2-chat-7B method does not have any markers; the description hallucinates that they are square.
The horizontal line for the LLaMA-2-chat-7B method is clearly below the 37 tick mark, at approximately 36.9, not 37.1.

errors.text_span: The ICD method, shown as a cyan dotted line with triangular markers, starts at an MCI of about 37.2 at 0 demonstrations, rises to a peak of approximately 38.1 at 1000 demonstrations, and then slightly decreases to about 37.8 at 2000 demonstrations.
errors.evidence: This entire sentence incorrectly describes the ICD method. In the plot, ICD is a single horizontal dashed line at a constant value of about 37.8. The description fabricates a complex trend, incorrectly states the line style is "dotted", and hallucinates "triangular markers".
The horizontal line for ICD is clearly below the 38 tick mark, at a value of approximately 37.8, not exactly 38.
